# Malta (MLT)

Found: NSO Malta news release NR 143/2024 "Homicides: 2014-2023" (2 Aug 2024) gives wilful-homicide victims by the six statistical districts (Northern Harbour, Southern Harbour, Northern, South Eastern, Western, Gozo and Comino) — but on the HTML page only as ten-year percentage shares of the 57 victims plus the highest/lowest district rate (Southern Harbour 1.6, Western 0.8 per 100,000). The district counts by sex are in Table 3 (xlsx), and the yearly national series in Table 1; both are behind bot-check and returned 403 to direct downloads and Python urllib (several user-agents, referer), and the web reader cannot read xlsx. Wayback availability data service returned 429. Charts on the page render "No Data Found" to a non-JS fetch.
- rows.csv therefore holds the percentage shares (unit "percent of victims", year "2014-2023"), the two rates, and the national totals/years given in the text. Counts per district would be 57 × share (e.g. 29.8% ≈ 17) but these are not written as values because they were not published as counts in the text.
- Next step for the user: download https://nso.gov.mt/wp-content/uploads/NR-2024-143-All-tablesn.xlsx in a browser; Table 3 has victims by district and sex (probably for 2014-2018 and 2019-2023 periods), Table 1 yearly events/victims 2014-2023.
- Not tried: Malta Police Force annual reports (pulizija.gov.mt) by police district (Malta has police districts A–K distinct from NSO statistical districts); NSO earlier releases "Crime and Criminal Justice" (older series); Eurostat crim_gen_reg.
